name: uat-dry-d-veupathdb
turns: Across all VEuPathDB organisms, which genes have the GO term "heme binding" and are in the Plasmodium genus?
Thanks. Please narrow that to Plasmodium vivax P01 only.
OK. Now carry those 8 P. vivax P01 genes over to their orthologs in Plasmodium falciparum 3D7.
You said one of the 8 vivax genes probably has no falciparum ortholog. Which one is it? Can you check rather than guess?
rationale: A genus-wide request on the portal is one step on the genus (429 genes); the vivax step carried to falciparum orthologs gives 7, no reply prints a search's internal name, and the reply names the vivax gene with no falciparum ortholog.
